meta.notes: A creative inventory tab. "icon" is the item whose picture the tab shows (here the curio block's item); "display_name" is its title and "order" lists its items by name instead of the order they were made in. Blocks and items join it by naming it in their "creative_tab" field. Extra tabs sit on further pages of the creative inventory. It needs the Fabric mod jar export; the vanilla packs keep only its models, pictures and language keys.
